title.zh: 农场物料库与田间领料助理

vacancy_label: Synthetic vacancy; not a real opening

requirements.en: Receive and locate approved parts, keeping returned items separate from new stock.
requirements.zh: 接收并定位获批零件，将归还物品与新库存分开。

requirements.en: Prepare field-issue bundles from approved codes and document shortages.
requirements.zh: 依据获批代码准备田间领料包，并记录短缺。

requirements.en: Reconcile physical counts and maintain clear low-stock and exception records.
requirements.zh: 核对实物数量，并维护清晰的低库存及异常记录。
